name: Discovery (STS-39)
about: Discovery (STS-39) (1991-031A), a crewed vehicle (OV-103), launched 1991 Apr 28. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1991 Apr 30), held fixed
GCAT names the site (KSC RW15); its coordinates are written from memory
